subject: DEC+J paper early view is up at SysBio

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: DEC+J paper early view is up at SysBio
parts:
Hi folks,

The Early View version of the DEC+J paper is up!  (Note: this is pre-corrections in proof, so there are some typos etc.)

Nicholas J. Matzke (2014). "Model Selection in Historical Biogeography Reveals that Founder-event Speciation is a Crucial Process in Island Clades." Systematic Biology, advance access August 14, 2014. doi: 10.1093/sysbio/syu056

http://sysbio.oxfordjournals.org/content/early/2014/08/14/sysbio.syu056.abstract

Cheers!
Nick

PS: The Dryad link is/will be: http://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.2mc1t
